// Deliberately not a `.ts` file: `boundary.test.ts` copies it INTO `packages/app/src` for one case
// and deletes it again, and `./credentials` only resolves from there. It is the shape that walked
// past the old hand-written list of receiver modules — a new internet-facing module that mints a
// credential, which nobody remembered to add to the list — so the rule has to find it unaided.
import { installationToken } from './credentials'

/** A receiver that mints its own installation token: the boundary the import-graph rule exists to
 *  hold, broken in the one way a list of filenames could not see. */
export const mintForDelivery = installationToken
